name: First Sunday Ride (BikeHouston)
schedule: First Sunday of every month, 8:00 am. The start park changes each month: Oct 4, 2026 is Terry Hershey Park (Art Sculpture, 15275 1/2 Memorial Dr).

start_location.name: Changes monthly. Oct 4, 2026: Terry Hershey Park, along Memorial Dr (Art Sculpture)

visitor_notes: Free and open to the public, no sign-up. The start park moves every month, so check the event page for the month you want. Bring a helmet and water.
description: BikeHouston's monthly neighborhood ride, free and open to everyone. Each month it starts from a different park or trail and rolls through a different part of the city. October's ride goes through the Energy Corridor in West Houston. EaDo Bike Co also rolls out for it.
evidence: BikeHouston's events page lists the First Sunday Ride for Sun Oct 4, 2026, 8:00 am at Terry Hershey Park; the Sept 6 ride was posted from Townwood Park (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Each month has its own event page (/events/first-sunday-ride-<month>-2026) with a ?format=ical link. The start location changes every month; do not geocode one park as the fixed start.

name: Sunday Starbucks Ride (NWCC, No Drop)
schedule: Every Sunday, 8:00 am Oct-Mar, 7:30 am Apr-Sep, from the Starbucks at Vintage Park (10805 Louetta Rd).
pace: Easy, Zone 2. Routes of 21, 32 or 42 miles; splits into speed groups if the turnout is big
visitor_notes: Open to members and non-members. Helmets required, no headphones. Be able to average about 14 mph. Ride status is posted on the Sunday Starbucks Ride Facebook page on Saturday afternoon. Coffee at the Starbucks after.
description: A true no-drop Sunday ride at an easy pace, from the Starbucks in Vintage Park. The host welcomes riders who are new to cycling and women riders. Routes of 21, 32 and 42 miles can be cut short, and the group stays together.
evidence: NWCC's events list shows the Sunday Starbucks Ride for Sun Oct 4, 2026 at 8:00 am, and the ride page gives 7:30 (Apr-Sep) and 8:00 (Oct-Mar) (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The events list shows the next dates. Start time moves to 7:30 am in April.

name: Hump Day Ride (NWCC)
schedule: Every Wednesday, 8:00 am year-round, from the Hockley Community Center. Arrive 30-45 minutes early.
pace: Be able to average 14 mph. Splits into speed and distance groups
visitor_notes: Open to members and non-members, no registration. Helmets required. Arrive 30-45 minutes before the start. Beer and a bite afterwards, buy your own.
description: A Wednesday-morning road ride of 25 to 45 miles from Hockley, with the group splitting by speed and distance. The route follows the wind and who shows up. The host calls it a good place for new riders and folks ramping back up.
evidence: NWCC's events list shows the Hump Day Ride for Wed Oct 7 and Oct 14, 2026 at 8:00 am from Hockley Community Center (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The events list posts each Wednesday.

name: Wednesday Night Ride (UBG Cycling Club)
visitor_notes: The page doesn't name the start; earlier listings say the club meets at the shop. Confirm with the shop at (713) 863-0991. Bring lights.
description: The Urban Bicycle Gallery Cycling Club's midweek evening road ride, about 20 miles at 18 to 20 mph.
evidence: UBG's club page lists the Wednesday Night Ride at 6:30 pm; the page images were uploaded Mar 20, 2026 (fetched Oct 1, 2026). No dated upcoming ride is shown.

name: Saturday Ride (UBG Cycling Club, A/B/C)
schedule: Every Saturday, 8:00 am, about 20 miles, A / B / C groups.
visitor_notes: The page doesn't name the start; earlier listings say the club meets at the shop. Confirm with the shop at (713) 863-0991.
description: The club's Saturday road ride, about 20 miles in three pace groups. The club calls it a more accessible ride, good for beginners or anyone who wants a more relaxed one.
evidence: UBG's club page lists the Saturday Ride at 8:00 am in A/B/C groups; the page images were uploaded Mar 20, 2026 (fetched Oct 1, 2026). No dated upcoming ride is shown.

name: First Saturday No-Drop Beginner Ride (UBG)
schedule: First Saturday of every month, ready to roll 9:30 am from the shop. 8-10 miles at 12-14 mph.
visitor_notes: Helmet, spare tube and CO2 required; no earphones. Minors under 16 need a parent. This listing sits on a third-party ride board, so confirm with the shop at (713) 863-0991 before you drive over.
description: A slow, no-drop road ride for new riders, on the first Saturday of the month. About 8 to 10 miles at 12 to 14 mph. The listing says the shop wants to add more beginner Saturdays.
evidence: A ride board's listing for this ride shows the next date as Sat Oct 3, 2026 at 9:30 am, monthly on the first Saturday (fetched Oct 1, 2026). The shop's own site doesn't list it.

refresh.notes: Listing is on a third-party ride board (neloscycles.com / resources.violetcrown.org), not the shop's site. Ask UBG to confirm.

name: Night Shop Ride (Pearland Bicycles)
schedule: Every Tuesday and Thursday, 6:00 pm, spring to Oct 29 (the shop page says March 11 to Oct 28). From the shop.
pace: Pace groups C 16-18, B 19-20, A 22+ mph
visitor_notes: Lights for the dark. Open to anyone, you don't need to be a customer. The series ends at the end of October and restarts in spring.
description: Pearland Bicycles' evening road ride, twice a week through the end of October. It splits into C, B and A groups by speed. Riders drive in from Houston, Sugar Land, Friendswood and Clear Lake.
evidence: The shop's Ride with GPS calendar feed lists Night Shop Ride on Tue Oct 6 and Thu Oct 8 through Thu Oct 29, 2026 at 6:00 pm (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The shop's RWGPS calendar.ics posts each night ride as its own event. The series ends Oct 29; re-check in March for the spring restart.

name: Saturday Shop Ride (Pearland Bicycles)
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:00 am, from the shop. Usually 45-50 miles.
pace: C 16-18 (no drop on older posts), B 19-20, A 22-24+ mph
visitor_notes: Open to anyone. Pick the pace group that fits you and arrive early if you're new. No in-ear headphones.
description: The shop's big Saturday road ride, usually 45 to 50 miles, in C, B and A pace groups. Riders come from across Houston.
evidence: The shop's ride page lists Saturdays at 7:00 am; its Ride with GPS calendar has a Saturday Shop Ride on Aug 29, 2026 (fetched Oct 1, 2026). Newer Saturdays are not posted as events.

refresh.notes: Shop page says hours subject to change. The RWGPS calendar's last Saturday event is Aug 29.

name: Sunday Coffee Ride (Pearland Bicycles)
schedule: Every Sunday, 7:30 am, 32-36 miles with a coffee stop in Missouri City or Friendswood.
visitor_notes: The coffee stop alternates between Bean Here Coffee in Missouri City and Pearland Coffee Roasters in Friendswood.
description: A Sunday-morning road ride of 32 to 36 miles from the shop, with a coffee stop that alternates between Missouri City and Friendswood. C and B groups.
evidence: The shop's ride page states Sundays at 7:30 am and the coffee-stop route (fetched Oct 1, 2026). The page carries no date, but the shop's Ride with GPS calendar posts rides through Oct 29, 2026.

refresh.notes: Page has no dates; the RWGPS calendar has no Sunday events lately.

name: Sugar Land Morning Rides (Motherland Cycling Club)
schedule: Every Tuesday and Thursday, roll out 6:30 am sharp, from the Shell station at 18725 University Blvd.
pace: Usually two groups: A 18-20 mph, B/C 15-17 mph
visitor_notes: Sign up to ride is linked on the club's event page. New club riders are asked to read the club's beginner orientation and bike laws pages first. Lights for early starts.
description: Motherland Cycling Club's early-morning ride from Sugar Land, Tuesdays and Thursdays. Two pace groups, A and B/C, and the pace follows who shows up. The club's Katy group rides at the same time.
evidence: Motherland's event pages show the Sugar Land Tuesday ride for Oct 6, 2026 and the Thursday ride for Oct 8, 2026, both 6:30 am (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Each event page shows the next date and repeats weekly. A Thursday event page is /events/mcc-sugar-land-thursday-morning-ride/.

name: Katy Morning Rides (Motherland Cycling Club)
schedule: Every Tuesday and Thursday, roll out 6:30 am, from Handlebar Cyclery. Typically 15-20 miles.
pace: Usually two groups: A 18-20 mph, B/C 15-17 mph
visitor_notes: Sign up to ride is linked on the club's event page. New club riders are asked to read the club's beginner orientation page first. Lights for early starts.
description: Motherland Cycling Club's early-morning ride from the Handlebar Cyclery shop in Katy, Tuesdays and Thursdays, 15 to 20 miles. The pace follows who shows up. The club's Sugar Land group rides at the same time, and the two groups join for a Saturday ride.
evidence: Motherland's event pages show the Katy Tuesday ride for Oct 6, 2026 and the Thursday ride for Oct 8, 2026, both 6:30 am, repeating weekly (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Each event page shows the next date and repeats weekly. The Thursday page is /events/mcc-katy-thursday-morning-ride/.

name: Tour de Woodlands Saturday Shop Ride (Bikeland)
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:30 am, from Whole Foods on Lakefront. 30 miles, back around 9:30 am.

start_location.name: Whole Foods Market, Hughes Landing
start_location.address: 1925 Hughes Landing Blvd, The Woodlands, TX 77380

pace: 14-16 mph, flat, leader-assisted with regroup points
visitor_notes: Helmet mandatory. Beginner and advanced riders both ride. The shop's page names a leader to email. Bike rack at the start for quick fixes.
description: Bikeland's Saturday shop ride, a flat 30 miles at 14 to 16 mph with regroups. The shop describes it as a leader-assisted no-drop ride with a big group and several levels. Coffee afterwards.
evidence: Bikeland's rides page states Saturdays at 7:30 am, and Bike The Woodlands Coalition's ride calendar (last updated Apr 24, 2026) lists the same start (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Page undated. BTWC's local ride calendar (bikethewoodlands.org/rides) is the dated cross-check.

name: Tuesday Shop Ride (Trek Bicycle The Woodlands)
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm, from Trek Bicycle The Woodlands. Two 15-mile loops.

start_location.name: Trek Bicycle The Woodlands
start_location.address: 4747 Research Forest Dr, Suite 145, The Woodlands, TX 77381

pace: 19-20 mph; splits into A and B groups when enough riders show
visitor_notes: A fast shop ride. Check the shop's Facebook page for changes. Lights in the darker months.

evidence: Bike The Woodlands Coalition's ride calendar (last updated Apr 24, 2026, rides as of May 2026) lists this Tuesday 6:00 pm shop ride (fetched Oct 1, 2026). The shop's own site doesn't list it.

name: The Woodlands MTB Dirt Church
schedule: Every Sunday, 9:00 am, from Rob Fleming Recreation Center. About 20 miles along the Spring Creek Nature Trail.

start_location.name: Rob Fleming Recreation Center
start_location.address: 6464 Creekside Forest Dr, The Woodlands, TX 77389

host.name: Community ride (listed by Bike The Woodlands Coalition)

visitor_notes: Sign up each week on the Chasing Watts app for updates. A cross-country mountain bike is recommended (roots and sand). Leave no trace and don't ride muddy trails. Air pump at the trailhead.
description: A community cross-country ride on the Spring Creek Nature Trail. The group goes west to Roy Burroughs Park or east to Grogan's Point Park, takes a water break and returns, about 20 miles.
evidence: Bike The Woodlands Coalition's ride calendar (last updated Apr 24, 2026, rides as of May 2026) lists this Sunday 9:00 am ride (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Secondary source only. The group posts each week on Chasing Watts.

description: The shop's Thursday evening road ride, about 23 miles. On the first Thursday of each month it turns into a slower, more social 10-mile ride where fat tires are welcome.
evidence: The shop's rides page states Thursday nights at 6:00 pm, and Bike The Woodlands Coalition's calendar (updated Apr 24, 2026) lists it at 6:15 pm that spring (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Page undated; times change by season.

schedule: Every Saturday, 7:30 am per the shop; starting times change through the seasons. Three groups: 50, 40 or 30 miles.
pace: A 20 mph (50 mi, drop ride), B 18 mph (40 mi), C 17 mph (30 mi)
visitor_notes: Helmets required. The shop calls the A group a drop ride. Bike The Woodlands listed an 8:00 am start in spring 2026, so confirm the start on the shop's Facebook page.
description: The shop's Saturday road ride in three groups: 50 miles at 20 mph, 40 miles at 18 mph and 30 miles at 17 mph. The A group is a drop ride.
evidence: The shop's rides page states Saturdays at 7:30 am, and Bike The Woodlands Coalition's calendar (updated Apr 24, 2026) lists 8:00 am that spring (fetched Oct 1, 2026).
